settings_subtitle: Manage music sources, selection rules, and appearance
selection_description: Randomly show a few choices from the enabled playlist or album, then play the card you select.
music_sources_hint: Paste a playlist or album share link, click Load, then enable one source. All changes are saved automatically.
about_title: DiscoAS - Let It Choose a Song
about_intro:
Randomly shows a few choices from your playlists or albums,
then plays your pick in a local music app.
features_list:
• Choose music quickly from a global shortcut or system tray
• Fullscreen floating window with random song cards
• Secret song mode for choice difficulty
• Customizable UI colors and sizes
usage_steps:
1. Add a playlist or album in the Choose tab
2. Click Load to fetch the song list
3. Enable one music source; changes are saved and applied automatically
4. Press Alt+D or use the tray menu to choose a song
cache_batches_hint: Number of song batches to preload, 0 disables preload
